production_rules: Production renders exactly three locked 1080x1620 portrait pages.
Header, approved STACORP logo, date lockup, skyline detail and navy/gold footer are immutable inside V2.
Typography is Teams-first: no critical story copy is rendered at the tiny sizes used by V1.
Page 1: item 1 hero + STACORP note + item 2 and item 3 secondary cards.
Page 2: item 4 full-width story + note; item 5 image-left/copy-right split + note.
Page 3: executive summary + exactly three executive actions + executive visual + five readable highlight cards + source panel + closing visual.
ChatGPT Images creates story illustrations only; it must never generate final newsletter pages, text, logo, badge or watermark.
Final pages are always rendered deterministically from the locked HTML/CSS templates.
Teams delivery uses a lossless 1440x2160 PNG master derived from the 2x browser render; it never upscales the 1080x1620 final page.
Each Teams hostedContent PNG must stay at or below 4 MiB or production fails.
Template hash, logo hash, output dimensions and geometry must pass before Teams posting.
No fallback template or lossy JPEG fallback is allowed.
Layout changes require explicit user approval and a new layout version.
